text: Seeds 22-23 at N=64 on data_seed 1 are still gaining 0.007-0.010 force margin per 500 steps at step 3000, while accel_step levels off at 0.163-0.165 from step 500. Does the per-seed N=64-to-N=128 trained force R2 drop (0.095-0.097 here) stay about 0.10 at 6000 steps? Or does it shrink as both arms converge, which would make the steps_per_orbit effect on force a matter of convergence speed?
